verses.english: Numbered Discourses 5.141
15. At Tikaṇḍakī
Scorn
“Mendicants, these five individuals are found in the world.
What five?

verses.pali: Datvā avajānāti, saṁvāsena avajānāti, ādheyyamukho hoti, lolo hoti, mando momūho hoti.
verses.english: One gives then scorns, one lives together then scorns, one is gullible for gossip, one is impulsive, and one is dull and stupid.
And how does an individual give then scorn?
It’s when an individual gives an individual robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick.
They think:
‘I give;
this one receives.’
They give to them, then they scorn them.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo datvā avajānāti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual gives then scorns.
And how does an individual live together then scorn?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṁ saṁvasati dve vā tīṇi vā vassāni.
verses.english: It’s when an individual lives with someone else for two or three years.
They live together with them, then they scorn them.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo saṁvāsena avajānāti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual lives together then scorns.
And how is an individual gullible for gossip?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo parassa vaṇṇe vā avaṇṇe vā bhāsiyamāne taṁ khippaññeva adhimuccitā hoti.
verses.english: It’s when they’re very quick to believe what a certain individual says in praise or criticism of another.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo ādheyyamukho hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is gullible for gossip.
And how is an individual impulsive?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo ittarasaddho hoti ittarabhattī ittarapemo ittarappasādo.
verses.english: It’s when a certain individual is fickle in faith, devotion, fondness, and confidence.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo lolo hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is impulsive.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, puggalo mando momūho hoti?
verses.english: And how is an individual dull and stupid?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kusalākusale dhamme na jānāti, sāvajjānavajje dhamme na jānāti, hīnappaṇīte dhamme na jānāti, kaṇhasukkasappaṭibhāge dhamme na jānāti.
verses.english: It’s when they don’t know the difference between qualities that are skillful and unskillful, blameworthy and blameless, inferior and superior, and those with a portion of dark or bright.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, puggalo mando momūho hoti.
verses.english: That’s how an individual is dull and stupid.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca puggalā santo saṁvijjamānā lokasmin”ti.
verses.english: These are the five individuals found in the world.”
